metadata.title: Claude Code Repos Index
metadata.description: Curated index of Claude Code-related resources and projects

categories.name: Systems Administration

repositories.name: Dolphin AI Actions

repositories.name: KDE Claude Runner

repositories.name: LAN Manager Plugin

repositories.name: Server Management Plugin
repositories.description: Early standalone Claude Code plugin with slash commands for server monitoring, deployment and administration.

repositories.name: Synology Manager Plugin
repositories.description: Claude Code plugin for administering a Synology NAS over SSH, with guided first-run setup, persistent context and commands for shares, volumes, mounts and storage monitoring. Workspaces for decision-making, personal planning, file management, and general-purpose productivity workflows. > **See also:** The [Budgeting](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Budgeting-Plugin), [Personal Planning](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Personal-Planning-Plugin), [Career](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Career-Plugin), [Purchasing](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Purchasing-Plugin), [Shopping](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Shopping-Plugin), and [Ideation & Planning](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Ideation-Planning-Plugin) cluster plugins in the [Plugins](#plugins) section cover these domains.

repositories.name: Agent-Assisted Purchase Research Index
repositories.description: Index of templates, skills and demos for agent-driven purchase research, built on decoupling the requirements spec from the current market.

repositories.name: Agentic Purchase Pipeline
repositories.description: Staged, agent-supported process for evaluating any purchase over about $50: capture the spec, find the requirements, survey the market, then score candidates against the spec.

repositories.name: Claude Decision Mapper
repositories.description: Codifies the iterative spec-refinement loop used with Claude for builds, hardware purchases and home-lab decisions — draft spec, correction, refinement — as reusable skills.

repositories.name: Claude Shopping Demo 2
repositories.description: Model workspace for a Claude shopping research tool customised by shop whitelist and task, with input and output folders.

repositories.name: Claude Shopping Eval Demo
repositories.description: Demo of Claude Code as a consumer purchasing assistant: a written spec plus retailer catalogue screenshots go in, a ranked recommendation report comes out (worked example: a portable Bluetooth speaker).

repositories.name: DVR Transcriber
repositories.description: Work-in-progress CLI and workspace for importing recordings from a digital voice recorder, organising them into dated folders, classifying them with AI and transcribing them. Workspaces and templates for legal research, case management, and evidence handling workflows. > **See also:** The [Legal & Investigative](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Legal-Investigative-Plugin) cluster plugin in the [Plugins](#plugins) section covers this domain — evidence logging, document analysis, redaction, and brief generation.

repositories.name: Claude Case File
repositories.description: Claude Code template for building version-controlled containers for legal files and case material. Workspaces and templates for health documentation, medical visit management, therapy tracking, and health-related research. > **See also:** The [Personal Planning](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Personal-Planning-Plugin) cluster plugin in the [Plugins](#plugins) section covers this domain — diary, health, therapy, preparedness, and personal development variants.

repositories.name: Claude ADHD Research Workspace
repositories.description: Research notebook investigating ADHD medication access, structured for sustained Claude-assisted enquiry.

repositories.name: Claude Mental Health Templates Index
repositories.description: Subindex of Claude Code templates, plugins and workspaces for mental health work a person does on their own material: organising events, tracking therapy, preparing for appointments.

repositories.name: Claude Therapy Workspace Template
repositories.description: GitHub template for working through one bounded personal issue with Claude Code — a career situation, a relationship, a bereavement — with sessions, threads and timelines kept in one workspace per issue. Workspaces and templates for content creation, blog management, writing workflows, and communications strategy.

repositories.name: Agentic Book Writing
repositories.description: Pattern spec for writing full-length reference and instructional books with Claude Code, using teams of subagents and the repository as shared memory, through to a print-on-demand paperback.

repositories.name: AI Video Production Template
repositories.description: Per-project workspace skeleton for producing one AI-generated video; the state half of a pair whose operational half is the `ai-video-producer` plugin (scripting, image-to-video and lip-sync pipelines).

repositories.name: Claude Book Workspace Template
repositories.description: Workspace scaffold implementing the Agentic Book Writing pattern: a `book.toml` manifest, spec and interview folders, binding prose and graphics style guides, and a status script for subagent-driven drafting.

repositories.name: Claude Website Update Sender
repositories.description: Automated workflow for sending polished update emails about website changes via Resend MCP.

repositories.name: Declaude
repositories.description: Personalized text rewriting rules that consolidate into a slash command for refining AI-generated documentation.

repositories.name: RTL Conformity Skills
repositories.description: Instruction-only agent skills that keep Hebrew, Arabic, Farsi and Urdu text right-to-left on every surface an agent writes to (Gmail, Resend, Google Docs/Sheets/Slides) and verify the setting took. Works in Claude and ChatGPT.

repositories.name: Writing Editing Plugin
repositories.description: Early standalone Claude Code plugin with slash commands for proofreading, style editing and text transformation. Workspaces and templates for budgeting, purchasing decisions, and personal finance management. > **See also:** The [Budgeting](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Budgeting-Plugin), [Purchasing](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Purchasing-Plugin), and [Shopping](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Shopping-Plugin) cluster plugins in the [Plugins](#plugins) section cover these domains.

repositories.name: Claude FX Pair Analyst Template
repositories.description: Claude Code workspace for FX pair analysis — historical data, quant and vol modelling, geopolitical context, and Typst PDF reports.

repositories.name: Israel Mortgage Research Skills
repositories.description: Work-in-progress skills basket for buyer-side Israeli residential mortgage research — track mix, Bank of Israel rules, DSR/LTV limits and bank quirks — before verified skills are folded into the Israel agent-skills plugin.

repositories.name: Israel Property Research Skills
repositories.description: Work-in-progress skills basket for Israeli property due diligence (Tabu extracts, building files, usage permits, comparables), aimed at non-professional buyers and tenants. Workspaces and templates for job searching, career planning, and professional development. > **See also:** The [Career](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Career-Plugin) cluster plugin in the [Plugins](#plugins) section covers this domain — role logging, offer comparison, application tracking, and salary benchmarking. Workspaces and templates for business planning, idea evaluation, and organizational continuity. > **See also:** The [Ideation & Planning](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Ideation-Planning-Plugin) cluster plugin in the [Plugins](#plugins) section covers business idea evaluation, decision frameworks, and simulation workflows. Workspaces and templates for document redaction, identity protection, and PII obfuscation. > **See also:** The [Legal & Investigative](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Legal-Investigative-Plugin) cluster plugin in the [Plugins](#plugins) section includes redaction and document-obfuscation workflows. For broader system hardening see the [Security Checkup](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Security-Checkup-Plugin) plugin.

repositories.name: Claude Anonymisation Assistant Plugin
repositories.description: Assistant configuration for redacting personally identifiable details from documents. Workspaces for hardware planning, PC builds, and technology procurement. > **See also:** The [Purchasing](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Purchasing-Plugin) (includes a tech-procurement variant), [Sysadmin & Homelab](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Sysadmin-Homelab-Plugin), and [HP5200 Printer](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-HP5200-Skill-plugin) plugins in the [Plugins](#plugins) section cover these domains.

repositories.name: Claude Pad

repositories.name: Claude Monitor Research

repositories.name: Home Media Planner
repositories.description: Non-code planning workspace for a home media setup: ideas, voice notes and reference material refined into requirements and decisions. Workspaces for SEO, web analytics, PR monitoring, and media tracking. > **See also:** The [PR & Media Work](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-PR-Media-Work-Plugin) cluster plugin in the [Plugins](#plugins) section covers coverage scanning, press summarisation, response drafting, and comms strategy.
